status_summary: No new national fatherhood messaging campaign and no allocation priority for faith-based or biological-basis fatherhood programs was found since 2025-01-20. On 2025-07-15 ACF posted the FORGE Fatherhood funding opportunity (about $55 million, 66 expected awards) under the HMRF program for responsible fatherhood activities in marriage, parenting and economic stability; it treats faith-based applicants on the same basis as others and refers to fathers or father figures. That listing is a standard HMRF grant competition and does not carry a messaging campaign or the requested priority.
title: Fund a pro-fatherhood messaging campaign and prioritize faith-based fatherhood programs
uncertainties: The FORGE Fatherhood listing was re-read during review; it does not mention a media or messaging campaign, says faith-based organizations may apply on the same basis as others, and does not say whether it continues an earlier fatherhood grant line. Its full notice document was not opened. A review search found Ad Council public service announcements on responsible fatherhood sponsored by the National Responsible Fatherhood Clearinghouse and ACF; the pages read carry no release dates, so whether any new campaign material was issued after 2025-01-20 is unknown and the long-running clearinghouse campaign is not counted as a step here (lead, unverified). The HEART notice and the HMRF performance measures notice were read by the researcher and do not address these items. Absence of evidence from a limited search, so confidence is capped.
